description: GBIF identifier for the source occurrence record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Read as text; records in the two regional pools intentionally overlap.

description: Reuse license attached to the source occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Record-level rights remain applicable; this package does not relicense source records.

description: Source record modification date or timestamp.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not the creation date of this final package.

description: Organization or agent publishing the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Preserved from the GBIF archive.

description: Links or citations associated with the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: May contain more than one reference.

description: Person or organization holding rights in the record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Preserved source attribution.

description: Identifier for the collection holding or documenting the material.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not a collecting-event identifier; preserve as text.

description: Source institution abbreviation or code.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Use alongside collectionCode and catalogNumber.

description: Source collection abbreviation or code.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Codes need not be globally unique.

description: Name of the dataset containing the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: See datasetKey for the GBIF dataset identifier.

description: Record category, such as preserved specimen or human observation.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: The final tables contain multiple record categories; they are not specimen-only.

description: Occurrence identifier supplied with the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Distinct from the GBIF-assigned gbifID; retain leading zeros and punctuation.

description: Catalog identifier assigned within the source collection.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: May repeat between collections; do not coerce to a number.

description: Collectors or observers associated with the occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Multiple agents may be represented in one cell.

description: Number of individuals reported by the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Blank is missing, not zero; observation counts are not standardized sampling effort.

description: Developmental stage reported for the organism.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Examples may include adult or larva; source terms are preserved.

description: Source or GBIF interpretation of presence or absence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: No additional presence-only filter was introduced during final packaging.

description: Preparation or preservation methods for the material.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: May list multiple preparations.

description: Date, time or interval assigned to the collecting or observation event.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Precision and any interval are preserved; do not assume every value identifies a single day.

description: Time or time interval associated with the event.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: No timezone is inferred when the source omits one.

description: First ordinal day associated with the event.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Useful for event intervals; blank remains missing.

description: Last ordinal day associated with the event.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Useful for event intervals; blank remains missing.

description: Event year interpreted in the source archive.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not the publication or download year.

description: Event month interpreted in the source archive.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Missing precision remains blank.

description: Event day of month interpreted in the source archive.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Missing precision remains blank.

description: Original event-date wording provided by the publisher.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: May differ in precision or format from eventDate.

description: Collecting or observation method reported by the source.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Retained even where sparse to keep the regional schemas identical.

description: Continent assigned to the occurrence location.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Source geographic interpretation is preserved.

description: Two-letter country code associated with the occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Preserved as text.

description: State or equivalent administrative unit for the occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: The source download was restricted to California.

description: County or equivalent administrative unit for the occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Retained in both tables, including blanks.

description: Source locality description associated with the occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not a determination that the record lies on Dangermond Preserve.

description: Original locality wording supplied with the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Source wording is preserved.

description: Latitude used in the geographic overlays.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Point coordinate; not an uncertainty envelope.

description: Longitude used in the geographic overlays.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Point coordinate; not an uncertainty envelope.

description: Reported radial uncertainty associated with the location.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Blank means unavailable, not zero; uncertainty was not used to buffer ecoregion assignments.

description: Source identifier for an identification assertion.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not the occurrence identifier.

description: People or agents associated with the source identification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Does not necessarily identify the provider of this project’s later name resolution.

description: Date or interval of the source identification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Distinct from service-query and user-review dates.

description: Identifier attached to the taxon in the source record.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Identifier namespace is source-dependent; do not equate with a COL XR key.

description: Kingdom in the original GBIF-interpreted classification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not recalculated after the project’s taxon-name changes.

description: Phylum in the original GBIF-interpreted classification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not recalculated after the project’s taxon-name changes.

description: Class in the original GBIF-interpreted classification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: The regional candidate analysis retained Insecta.

description: Order in the original GBIF-interpreted classification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not recalculated after the project’s taxon-name changes.

description: Family in the original GBIF-interpreted classification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not recalculated after the project’s taxon-name changes.

description: Genus in the original GBIF-interpreted classification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: May differ from the genus of resolved_taxon_name following a name change.

description: Rank of the original GBIF-interpreted identification.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not necessarily the rank of resolved_taxon_name after user-approved changes.

description: Taxonomic status recorded in the original GBIF interpretation.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not the final project acceptance status; see taxon_resolution_description.

description: GBIF identifier for the dataset contributing the occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Can be used to retrieve source dataset provenance from GBIF.

description: Legacy GBIF taxon key assigned in the original download.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Preserved source key; not updated to the resolved COL XR name.

description: Legacy GBIF accepted-taxon key in the original download.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Preserved source key; not a new resolved-name identifier.

description: Scientific-name text originally supplied by the publisher.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Preserved without replacement; can be blank and may differ from the GBIF-interpreted name sent to the service.

description: Final project-accepted canonical scientific name.
provenance: Project name-resolution workflow and user review
notes: Uses GBIF Species Match API v2 / COL XR results and explicit user decisions; may retain subspecies or other finer ranks.

description: Readable account of the name match and acceptance decision.
provenance: Project name-resolution workflow and user review
notes: Includes provider, original match type/confidence/status, GBIF-interpreted service input and any user-review note. Confidence is a matching score, not a probability that a specimen identification is correct.

description: Project identifier or identifiers supplied with the source occurrence.
provenance: Original GBIF Darwin Core occurrence archive; retained unchanged
notes: Not an identifier created for this repository; original archive allows semicolon-separated values.

description: EPA Level III code assigned by the project’s geographic overlay.
provenance: Project overlay of EPA polygons
notes: Represents full regional membership, not preserve membership; both exports retain this field.

description: EPA Level III name corresponding to the assigned code.
provenance: Project overlay of EPA polygons
notes: Codes and names correspond in order when multiple labels occur.

description: ESA common name matched to the resolved taxon, parent species or approved binomial alias.
provenance: Project exact-name/approved-alias join to ESA list
notes: No source match leaves a blank. Subspecies-only common names are not generalized to the parent species.

description: Organization supplying the proposed common name.
units_or_format: Entomological Society of America (ESA), or blank
provenance: Project exact-name/approved-alias join to ESA list
notes: This package used the ESA list, not BugGuide.

description: Exact ESA spreadsheet download used for the assignment.
provenance: Project exact-name/approved-alias join to ESA list
notes: Source spreadsheet and checksum are retained in data/raw/common-names/esa/2026-10-27/.
